_from: docs/game-guide/templates/art-config.json. More Clan Quest banners, one per new clan name word (shared/clans/words.ts CLAN_NOUNS), matching src/games/clans/art/banners.

pictures.name: dragons
pictures.prompt: Painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, suitable for children aged 8 to 12. A single old weathered cream linen clan banner hanging from a dark wooden crossbar with iron finial ends and a small hanging loop, the cloth tied on with fabric tabs, a swallowtail pointed bottom edge with slightly frayed and burnt torn edges, a large bold painted emblem in the middle of the cloth: a fierce red dragon rearing up with wings spread. Front view, the whole banner visible and centred with space all around, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around. No text, no letters.
